name: The Frontier Trail

text.title: THE FRONTIER TRAIL
text.subtitle: Two thousand miles of dust, rivers and bad decisions.

whisperer.name: Ox Whisperer
whisperer.perk: Draft animals tire ½ as fast, calms herds

medic.name: Doctor
medic.perk: Cures once a day, revives 2× faster

events.name: Wild Berries
events.text: You find bushes heavy with wild berries.

outcomes.text: Delicious. Everyone feels better.
{target} ate far too many and now has the munchies.
You pack 12 lbs of berries.
You leave them for the birds.

events.name: Lost Trail
events.text: The trail disappears into tall grass. Nobody is sure which way it goes.

outcomes.text: You find the trail again. You lost 2 days.
Your gut was right! No time lost.
Your gut was wrong. You lose 4 days.

events.name: Heavy Fog
events.text: A fog so thick you can't see the {draft} in front of the {wagon}.

outcomes.text: The fog lifts after a day.
You feel your way through it.
You got turned around in the fog…

events.name: Abandoned Wagon
events.text: An abandoned {wagon} sits by the trail. It might have supplies. It might have something else.

outcomes.text: You find a spare wheel and 30 lbs of food!
A few scraps: 10 lbs of food.
Something was sleeping inside. It bites {target}!
You leave it alone. Probably wise.

events.name: Bad Water
events.text: The only water around is brown, warm and has a smell.

outcomes.text: It tastes… fine? Everyone feels a bit off.
You boil every drop. A day lost, everyone fine.
Your medic purifies it. Safe and free.
Safe to drink.

events.name: Friendly Locals
events.text: Some locals wave you down. They want to trade.

outcomes.text: A fair deal.

choices.label: Trade 40 lbs food for a spare wheel

outcomes.text: You got a spare wheel.
What a deal: 80 lbs of food for one set of clothes!
They got annoyed and left.
You wave goodbye.

events.name: Runaway {draftOne}
events.text: One of the {draft} wandered off during the night.

outcomes.text: You found it munching grass behind a hill.
It's gone. You lost one {draftOne}.
You lost one {draftOne}.
It came back on its own! Good {draftOne}.

events.name: Perfect Weather
events.text: Blue sky, gentle breeze, the {draft} are in a great mood.

outcomes.text: You make great time. +12 miles.
Best night of the trip.

events.name: The Peddler
events.text: A peddler offers a Mystery Box for {sym}60. "No refunds."

outcomes.text: Three crates of food!
A spare wheel and a spare axle!
Two bottles of medicine.
A pizza. Pepperoni and cheese.
It's empty except for a note: "sucker". Bad luck follows.
The peddler shrugs and rolls on.

events.name: A Familiar Grave
events.text: A weathered tombstone by the trail. Here lies {graveName}, who died of {graveCause}. "{graveEpitaph}"

outcomes.text: You pay your respects. F.
You dig up 15 lbs of food. Somewhere, a ghost is annoyed.
"{graveEpitaph}" — the words hang in the air.

events.name: A Shortcut?
events.text: A hand-painted sign: "SHORTCUT (TRUST ME)".

outcomes.text: It actually works! 40 miles saved.
It leads through a bog. The next river will be deeper.
You ignore the sign. Good instincts.

events.name: Giant Pothole
events.text: The {wagon} hits a pothole the size of a bathtub. Hold on!

outcomes.text: Everyone made it back on the {wagon}.
Someone got dragged a quarter mile.
Half the party is eating dirt, and the ammo box burst open.

events.name: Snack Thieves
events.text: A gang of raccoons is making off with your food crates!

outcomes.text: You tackled every last one. All food recovered!
You got most of it back.
They got away with 75 lbs of food.
You let them have a crate. They look grateful.

events.name: {draft} Strike
events.text: The {draft} refuse to move. They want a song. A real one. Everyone.

outcomes.text: The {draft} are moved to tears. They pull with new vigour!
That was not a song. The {draft} sulk for a day.
25 lbs of food later, they're happy to go.
You wait them out. A day lost.

events.name: Dysentery Speedrun
events.text: {target} needs a bush. Now. The nearest bush is VERY far away.

outcomes.text: {target} made it! Cured by sheer willpower.
{target} did not make it in time. We don't talk about it.
{target} holds it in. Heroic, but ill-advised.

events.name: Strange Fumes
events.text: A sweet-smelling mist rolls over the trail. The {draft} start giggling.

outcomes.text: Everything is wobbly. Controls are reversed at the next stop.
You hold your breath. Only some of you are affected.

events.name: Funny Mushrooms
events.text: You find a patch of big, friendly-looking mushrooms.

outcomes.text: Your heads swell to twice their size. Doorways are now a challenge.
Probably wise.

events.name: Talent Show
events.text: Travellers are holding a talent show. First prize: {sym}100. Judged on FACES.

outcomes.text: The crowd loves {winner}! +{sym}100.
The crowd throws tomatoes. Free food, at least.
You watch from the back.

events.name: Greased {wagon}
events.text: Someone spilled a barrel of grease all over the {wagon} bed. There's a hill ahead.

outcomes.text: You scrub the {wagon} for a day.
You caught everything that slid out!
Some of it rolled into a ravine.
Half the cargo is at the bottom of the hill.

events.name: Goose Heist
events.text: A goose grabs {meme} and waddles off at speed!

outcomes.text: You tackled the goose. {meme} is safe.
It got away with {meme}. Never forget.
{meme} is gone. Pour one out.

events.name: Tourists!
events.text: A coach of tourists wants a photo with real trail pilgrims.

outcomes.text: Great photo! The tourists tip {sym}80.
Somebody ruined the photo. The tourists leave, disappointed.
You roll past. They take a photo of your backside.

events.name: Stuck in the Mud
events.text: The {wagon} sinks up to its axles in mud.

outcomes.text: With a mighty heave, the {wagon} is free!
The mud wins. 2 days of digging.
Lighter now, the {wagon} rolls free.
Two days later, the mud lets go.

events.name: Wheel's Off!
events.text: CRACK. A wheel shatters and the {wagon} slumps into the dirt.

outcomes.text: Wheel replaced. Back on the trail!
It took all day, but the new wheel is on.
Jury-rigged! Good as new (ish).
The jury-rig collapses. You limp on.
You limp along on three wheels.

events.name: Broken Axle
events.text: The axle snaps with a sound like a gunshot.

outcomes.text: New axle in. Back on the trail!
It took all day, but it's in.
Lashed together with rope and hope. It holds!
It didn't hold. You limp on.
You drag the {wagon} along.

events.name: Snakebite
events.text: A snake bites {target}!

outcomes.text: Medicine applied. {target} will be fine.
Your medic handles it like a pro.
{volunteer} sucks the venom out. Gross, but it worked.
{volunteer} got a mouthful of venom. Now they're both sick.
{target} tries to walk it off.

events.name: Sickness
events.text: {target} looks terrible. Something is going around.

outcomes.text: You rest for two days.
The medicine works.
You push on. {target} feels worse.

events.name: Night Thieves
events.text: Something is rummaging through your supplies in the dark.

outcomes.text: You chased them off with everything intact.
They got away with a little.
By the time you found the lantern, they were gone.
By morning, 60 lbs of food and a set of clothes are gone.

events.name: Flash Flood
events.text: A wall of water comes roaring down the gully!

outcomes.text: Everything reached high ground. Soaked, but safe.
Some of the food got soaked.
The flood takes food, clothes and ammo.
You survive. Your supplies mostly don't.

events.name: Fire!
events.text: A lantern tips over. The {wagon} is on fire!

outcomes.text: Fire out! Only a little singed.
Fire out, but the food and clothes took a beating.
It burned for a long time.
You watch it burn. It takes a lot with it.

events.name: Stampede!
events.text: The ground shakes. A herd is coming straight at the {wagon}!

outcomes.text: The herd thunders past. Everyone's okay.
{target} got trampled and some food was lost.
Chaos. Everyone is bruised and a {draftOne} ran off with the herd.
Your animal whisperer turns the herd aside. Legend.

events.name: Toll Bridge
events.text: Three large, rude people block the only bridge. "Toll's {sym}100."

outcomes.text: You pay. They laugh.
Your banker talks them down to {sym}50.
You tossed them in the river! They drop {sym}40.
They beat you up and take the toll anyway.
You sneak past in the dark.
Caught! They take double.
The long way round costs 3 days.

events.name: Snatched!
events.text: A huge bird swoops down and grabs {target}!

outcomes.text: The bird drops {target} into a soft bush. Saved!
It drops {target} on a high rock. It takes a day to get them down.
{target} is carried off… and dropped a mile back. They walk.

events.name: Cold Snap
events.text: The temperature drops like a stone. Frost on everything.

outcomes.text: You huddle together for two days.
Without enough clothes, everyone suffers.
Your clothes keep the worst of it off.

choices.label: Burn a spare wheel for warmth

outcomes.text: The spare wheel burns merrily. Everyone is toasty.

events.name: Hangry
events.text: Food is running low. People are getting snippy.

outcomes.text: Time to hunt!
Belts tighten.
You ate {meme}. You will carry this forever.

events.name: THE BEAST
events.text: The ground splits. Something ENORMOUS rises and it's looking at your food.

choices.label: FIGHT IT
choices.hint: hit the weak spot / wrestle it (physical)

outcomes.text: You slayed the beast! Its hoard is yours.
It retreats, wounded. So are you.
It ate half your supplies and all of your dignity.
It takes {meme}, sniffs it, and leaves peacefully.
You outran it!
It snapped at the stragglers.

events.name: LAUNCH
events.text: The ground hisses. A geyser erupts right under the {wagon}!

outcomes.text: You land 60 miles ahead and gather everything!
You land 60 miles ahead. Some things didn't.
60 miles ahead, bruised, and missing half the cargo.

events.name: Déjà Vu
events.text: You wake up. It's yesterday. Again.

outcomes.text: The day repeats. Choose better this time.
You refuse. The day passes anyway.

events.name: Soul Swap
events.text: Lightning strikes the {wagon}. Two of you feel… different. (Everyone must agree.)

choices.label: Everyone agrees
choices.hint: two players swap bodies until camp

outcomes.text: Two of you wake up in the wrong body.
Someone said no. Consent is sacred, even on the trail.

events.name: The Ghost Wagon
events.text: A translucent {wagon} pulls up. Its passengers died on this very trail. They want a race.

outcomes.text: The ghosts bless you: full health, and one of the fallen returns!
The ghosts win. {target} joins them until camp.
The ghost wagon fades… with a set of your clothes.

events.name: A Divine Offer
events.text: The sky opens. A god offers to bring {dead} back — for a price.

outcomes.text: {dead} gasps back to life!
The god takes {meme}. {dead} returns!
{dead} returns. Someone now wears the Hat of Shame.
You honour the fallen.

epitaphs: forded when they should have ferried
died doing what they loved: bad decisions
I told you I was sick
they tried their best (it was not good)
memes: Caulk the wagon and float it.
the trail giveth, the trail taketh

shopkeeper.name: Matt
lines: Welcome! Buy what you can carry.

ferryman.name: The Ferryman
lines: Five dollars and I'll get you across.
Keep your hands inside the ferry.

talker_1.name: An old settler
lines: The river ahead is deeper than it looks.
Rest when you're sick. Trust me.

talker_2.name: A tired pilgrim
lines: We lost our wheel two days back.

talker_3.name: A kid
lines: Are you going to die of dysentery?
